title: lithophragma glabrum subsp. bulbiferum
intro: Lithophragma glabrum subsp. bulbiferum, commonly known as Western wintergreen, is a plant species in the Saxifragaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties and health benefits, including its potential to act as a diuretic, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Western wintergreen include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. Western wintergreen is also used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues.
